start_here: Say to your AI: "Measure the reference video ref/launch-teaser.mp4 into a new folder ref/measured with my hf-media, motion tools and earshot Python." It runs tool:measure-a-reference-video.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list of yours: it writes review files for one video into a new folder you name.
instructions: 1. Pick the video and a new, empty output folder. Find where hf-media, the motion tools folder (it holds motion-rhythm.mjs) and a Python with earshot are installed; never guess a folder.

2. Say to your AI: "Measure this reference video". It reads the row with tools:list and runs python3 -I tools/keep-a-record-library-valid/do-work/keep_a_record_library.py measure-reference ref/launch-teaser.mp4 ref/measured --hf-media <path to hf-media> --motion-tools <folder> --earshot-python <python>
3. Every program is checked first; a missing one exits 2 with a line such as "measure: give --hf-media, the installed hf-media executable" and nothing is measured.
4. Read the last JSON line: {"measured": true, "video", "out", "duration_s", "files"} or {"measured": false, "failed": ...} (exit 1; the .err files in the folder say why).
5. This is evidence still to be reviewed: open the sheets and pages before describing the video. A film over 120 seconds gets small labelled review pages (review-pages) instead of one contact sheet.

worked_examples.title: A 12.4 second reference video measured
worked_examples.ask: Measure ref/launch-teaser.mp4 so I can learn from it.
worked_examples.given: Read from tools/keep-a-record-library-valid/do-work/measure-reference.sh (it needs hf-media, so it was not run here; its refusal for a missing hf-media was run and printed "measure: give --hf-media, the installed hf-media executable" with exit 2): python3 -I tools/keep-a-record-library-valid/do-work/keep_a_record_library.py measure-reference ref/launch-teaser.mp4 ref/measured --hf-media <path to hf-media> --motion-tools <folder holding motion-rhythm.mjs> --earshot-python <python with earshot> on a made-up 12.4 second video.
worked_examples.hands_back: Exit 0 and the last line: {"measured": true, "video": "ref/launch-teaser.mp4", "out": "ref/measured", "duration_s": 12.4, "files": ["earshot-timeline.txt", "probe.json", "rhythm.json", "scan", "scan.json", "sheet-1fps", "sheet-hook"]} (the files are sorted; a video over 120 seconds also lists review-pages and review-pages.json). On a failed step: {"measured": false, "video": ..., "out": ..., "duration_s": 12.4, "failed": "hf-media evidence (see sheet.err, scan.err)"} with exit 1.
